loopback.scope: Actual local TCP/codec readback of paced Home and all256 bytes in both directions. Local event boundaries are observed, never guaranteed for arbitrary networks. No modem, DOS, BBS editor or physical hardware claim.

actual_DOS.login_readiness: WAITFOR plus reused one-shot WHEN latch

receiveTrace.scope: Diagnostic export daemon/chardev added; existing DSP dumps and host timestamps, no DSP binary changes.

gateway.sourceScope: Synthetic ATZ/ATD1 front end only; online bytes cross actual external/internal SIP, CallSession/pool, RTP, originating and guest answering DSP, and Telnet. DOSBox UART/modem status lines remain emulated.

editor.scope: Actual BIOS editor keys; one-line page keys test boundaries, no multiline scrolling. Connection closes with an unsaved draft; no Save command is sent.

actual_DOS.scope: Actual source-built DOS terminal and ASPECT directory script through synthetic local Hayes control and real external/internal SIP, CallSession, pool, originating/guest DSP and Telnet to owned stock ENiGMA. No physical modem/ATA/UART acceptance.

editor.scope: Actual BIOS-to-serial key sequence and authoritative editor cursor/mode responses. Page keys cover a one-line boundary only; connection closes without Save.

independent_audit.scope: Independent read-only actual DOS/ASPECT, BBS authoritative logs, guest frames, serial/Telnet byte identity, RTP continuity, SIP and cleanup audit. No physical modem/ATA claim.

offline_caller.scope: Offline native QAM receiver over the observed external caller RTP packets. This does not establish what the in-VM PJSIP jitter buffer or proprietary receiver consumed.

integrity_diagnosis.scope: Read-only actual serial/guest/Telnet comparison and independent captured-caller QAM decode. Diagnosis verification means a reproduced failure, not transport acceptance. Guest PCM/arrival timing are captured and require their separate waveform analysis; this byte comparison alone does not establish a media cause. Terminal-close truncation is not automatically acoustic corruption.

PCM_analysis.scope: Exact G.711 decoding/frame-hash alignment and observed host UDP arrival times. Changed guest PCM proves a media-path difference, not its internal cause. No physical modem/ATA.

offline_guest.scope: Offline native QAM decode of actual guest pre-resampling 8kHz PCM. Distinct from the proprietary guest DSP; no injected live bytes or connection flags.

limitations: The serial-output recorder represents frontend send attempts. Screen snapshots validate the pre-close DOS editor state; DSP output during diagnostic export after serial-close is not proof DOS received those later bytes.
One-line page keys exercise document boundaries, not multiline scrolling. No post is saved and no file transfer is attempted.
A clean traced call does not fix the preserved normal-image byte-insertion failures. Complete editor/reset/receive acceptance remains separate.
scope: Opt-in250ms bridge key framing on the carrier image (with existing diagnostic PCM export only when declared), actual local stock ENiGMA one-line editor recipe, loopback byte readback and independent captures. PCM identity covers its recorded overlap, not the longer RTP export/shutdown tail. A scoped pass does not guarantee arbitrary remote TCP chunking, physical hardware, transfers, other rates or complete application functionality. Earlier receive-corruption failures remain unresolved.
